mapper.select: select a.user_id userName,c.real_name realName, regexp_replace(LISTAGG( d.asset_type, ',') WITHIN GROUP (order by (d.asset_type)) ,'([^,]+)(,\1)*(,|$)','\1\3') finprodType2,c.DEPT_CODE deptCode from sys_user_role a inner join sys_role b on a.role_id = b.role_id inner join sys_user c on a.user_id=c.user_name left join AUTO_DISPENSE_RIGHT d on a.user_id=d.user_id where b.role_pos = '06' group by a.user_id,c.real_name,c.DEPT_CODE
mapper.sql: #{busiTypePosition} busiTypePosition, tpd.totle_trade_id totleTradeId, tpd.trade_id tradeId, tpda.portfolio_id portfolioId, tpda.ENTRUST_ID entrustId, pp.portfolio_name portfolioName, fp.finprod_market_id finprodMarketId, fp.finprod_abbr finprodAbbr, tpd.ps ps, tpd.TRADE_MARKET tradeMarket, ssai.sec_acct_name secAcctId, ssai.TRD_ACCT_ID trdAcctId, tpd.FINPROD_TYPE2 finprodType2, tpd.SHARE_AMT shareAmt, tpd.UNIT_FPRICE unitFprice, tpd.FPRICE_AMT fpriceAmt, to_char(tpd.CREATE_TIME,'hh24:mi:ss') tradeTime, to_char(EE.ENTRUST_DATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') entrustDate, to_char(EEA.TRANSMIT_TIME,'hh24:mi:ss') transmitTime, EEA.TRADER trader, to_char(tpd.trade_date,'yyyy-MM-dd') tradeDate, DECODE(tpd.settle_speed,0,'01',1,'02','2','03') settleSpeed, to_char(tpd.settle_date,'yyyy-MM-dd') settleDate, tpd.unit_cprice unitPrice, tpd.yield*100 matureYield, tpd.exer_yield*100 exerYield, tpd.share_amt/100 shareNum, tpd.unit_int unitInt, tpd.unit_fprice allPrice, tpd.cprice_amt cpriceAmt, tpd.int_amt intAmt, tpd.fprice_amt fpriceAmt, ttft.fee_amt jyFeeAmt, ttft1.fee_amt jsFeeAmt, tpd.ccy ccy, tpd.counter_id counterId, mcp.counter_name counterName, tpd.remark remark, ftp.TERM_TYPE termType, ftp.TERM repoTerm, TO_CHAR(FTP.VPAY_DATE,'YYYY-MM-DD') vpayDate,/*首次结算日*/ TO_CHAR(FTP.MPAY_DATE,'YYYY-MM-DD') mpayDate,/*到期结算日*/ ftp.ACT_CAP_DAYS actCapDays, ftp.INT_RATE * 100 rebackPrice, TPD.TRADE_AMT tradeAmt, FTP.M_INT_AMT mIntAmt, /*回购利息*/ FTP.M_TRADE_AMT mTradeAmt,/* 到期金额*/ FTP.M_UNIT_CPRICE mCprice, FTP.M_YIELD * 100 mYield, FIN_DEAL_PLEDGE.PLEDGE_NUMBER * 100 secTotalPrin
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT su.USER_NAME userName, su.REAL_NAME realName, to_char(NVL(a.totalWork,0),'fm999990.009') as totalWork, to_char(NVL(b.unfinishedWork,0),'fm999990.009') as unfinishedWork FROM SYS_USER su INNER JOIN SYS_USER_ROLE sur ON su.USER_NAME = sur.USER_ID INNER JOIN SYS_ROLE sr ON sur.ROLE_ID = sr.ROLE_ID AND sr.ROLE_POS in (06) LEFT JOIN ETR_DISTRIBUTE ed ON ed.TRADER=su.USER_NAME LEFT JOIN ( SELECT edi.TRADER as TRADER, round(COUNT(edi.TRADER),2) AS totalWork FROM ETR_DISTRIBUTE edi LEFT JOIN ETR_ENTRUST een ON edi.ENTRUST_ID = een.ENTRUST_ID INNER JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO ON PTL_PORTFOLIO.PORTFOLIO_ID = een.PORTFOLIO_ID INNER JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO_AUTHORITY ON PTL_PORTFOLIO_AUTHORITY.PORTFOLIO_ID = PTL_PORTFOLIO.PORTFOLIO_ID AND edi.TRADER = PTL_PORTFOLIO_AUTHORITY.USER_ID where een.ENTRUST_STATUS in ('02','03','04') GROUP BY edi.TRADER) a ON su.USER_NAME = a.TRADER LEFT JOIN ( SELECT edi.TRADER as TRADER, round(COUNT(edi.TRADER),2) AS unfinishedWork FROM ETR_DISTRIBUTE edi LEFT JOIN ETR_ENTRUST een ON edi.ENTRUST_ID = een.ENTRUST_ID INNER JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO ON PTL_PORTFOLIO.PORTFOLIO_ID = een.PORTFOLIO_ID INNER JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO_AUTHORITY ON PTL_PORTFOLIO_AUTHORITY.PORTFOLIO_ID = PTL_PORTFOLIO.PORTFOLIO_ID AND edi.TRADER = PTL_PORTFOLIO_AUTHORITY.USER_ID where een.ENTRUST_STATUS in ('02','03') GROUP BY edi.TRADER) b ON b.TRADER=su.USER_NAME
mapper.sql: #{busiTypePosition} busiTypePosition, tpdp.trade_id tradeId, tpdp.ENTRUST_ID entrustId, tpdp.ACCT_ID acctId, tpdp.TRADE_MARKET tradeMarket, to_char(tpdp.trade_date,'yyyy-MM-dd') exeDate, to_char(tpdp.settle_date,'yyyy-MM-dd') tradeDate, #{quoteType} busiType, tpdp.portfolio_id portfolioId, pp.portfolio_name portfolioName, fp.finprod_market_id finprodMarketId, fp.finprod_abbr finprodAbbr, tpdp.ps ps, ssai.sec_acct_name secAcctId, DECODE(tpdp.settle_speed,0,'01',1,'02','2','03') settleSpeed, to_char(tpdp.settle_date,'yyyy-MM-dd') settleDate, tpdp.unit_cprice unitPrice, tpdp.yield*100 matureYield, tpdp.exer_yield*100 exerYield, tpdp.share_amt/100 shareNum, tpdp.unit_int unitInt, tpdp.unit_fprice allPrice, tpdp.cprice_amt cpriceAmt, tpdp.int_amt intAmt, tpdp.fprice_amt fpriceAmt, ttft.fee_amt jyFeeAmt, ttft1.fee_amt jsFeeAmt, tpdp.ccy ccy, tpdp.clear_type settleType, tpdp.COUNTER_ID counterId, nvl(mcp.counter_name,tpdp.COUNTER_ID) counterName, nvl(mcct.trader_name,tpdp.COUNTER_TRADER) counterTrader, tpdp.remark remark, tpdp.Delivery_Type deliveryType, TO_CHAR(T6.EXERCISE_DATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') exerciseDate, TO_CHAR(T6.ACT_EXERCISE_DATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') actExerciseDate, tpdp.TOTLE_TRADE_ID totalTradeId, EE.ENTRUST_NUM entrustNum, EE.PRICE price, EE.ENTRUST_AMT entrustAmt, EE.ENTRUST_STATUS entrustStatus, EFS.FINISH_AMT finishAmt, to_char(EE.ENTRUST_DATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') entrustDate, to_char(EEA.TRANSMIT_TIME,'hh24:mi:ss') transmitTime, DECODE(EE.ENTRUST_NUM,null,null,ROUND(EE.ENTRUST_AMT/EE.ENTRUST_NUM,4)) clinchPrice, CASE WHEN EEA.TARGET_TYPE = '01' THEN ROUND(EFS.ENT_FINISH_AMT/EE.ENTRUST_NUM,4) ELSE ROUND(EFS.ENT_FINISH_AMT/EE.ENTRUST_AMT,4) END dealPercent, EEA.TRADER trader, tpdp.FINPROD_TYPE2
mapper.select: SELECT T1.REAL_NAME realName FROM SYS_USER T1 where T1.USER_NAME = #{userName}

select listagg(ea.DISPENSE_PARA,',') WITHIN GROUP ( order by er.VDATE) distributeParameter, er.DISPENSE_RULE distributeRule, to_char(er.VDATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') vdate, to_char(er.MDATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') mdate from ETR_AUTO_DISPENSE_RULE er left join ETR_AUTO_DISPENSE_RULE_DETAIL ea on er.RULE_ID = ea.RULE_ID
and er.VDATE <= to_date(#{sysDate},'yyyy-mm-dd') and er.MDATE >= to_date(#{sysDate},'yyyy-mm-dd')
group by er.DISPENSE_RULE, er.VDATE, er.MDATE

select OUTPUT_VALUE_1 from FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE_CONFIG btm left join ETR_ENTRUST ON (ETR_ENTRUST.FINPROD_TYPE2 = btm.INPUT_VALUE_2 OR btm.INPUT_VALUE_2 is null) AND (ETR_ENTRUST.Ps = btm.INPUT_VALUE_3 OR btm.INPUT_VALUE_3 is null) AND (ETR_ENTRUST.TRADE_PLAT = btm.INPUT_VALUE_1 OR btm.INPUT_VALUE_1 IS NULL) where ETR_ENTRUST.ENTRUST_ID=#{entrustId}
